purpose: Add reviewed Manager English and Japanese articles to the existing publication package. This is editorial inventory, not task status or a publication receipt.
citation_count_note: The first two articles preserve already deployed citation counts. Other manuscripts use zero to suppress the optional citation-count label because no independently enumerated paper count is asserted; their source links remain in the text.

articles.title: Why Real-World Agents Need Small Evidence Cards, Not Another Giant Database
articles.description: A small source-linked evidence registry and guardrails against inflated claims.

articles.title: Population Is Not Behavior, and Behavior Is Not Causality
articles.description: A source-grounded map of population synthesis, human behavior prediction, social simulation, and causal intervention.

articles.title: A Great Manager Doesn't Just Get Things Done. They Prove Things Got Better.
articles.description: What management research can teach an AI system about objectives, authority, outcomes, and evidence.

articles.title: Why Prediction Is Not Intervention: Building an AI That Can Prove It Helped
articles.description: The missing links between forecasting people, authorized action, and independently measured improvement.

articles.description: Artificial Societies' Radiant workflows, published evidence, and the limitations of simulated human behavior.

articles.description: An open research proposal and runnable synthetic EBA-v0, with boundaries for causal and welfare claims.
